studies.name: Folded white point mesh
intentionalDifferences: Independent pinched continuous sheet opens into two locally twisting wings; extra point contours emphasize the fold.
Original parametric surface and local ripples; source formula and complete timing are not reproduced.

studies.name: Curling point gesture
intentionalDifferences: Independent tapering curled tube with a dense lower body and a family of fine upper contour trails.
The archived feed sample is cropped; this is a source-led gesture, not a full-frame or exact-motion reconstruction.

studies.name: Connected mesh loops
intentionalDifferences: Independent continuous figure-eight surface and offset connected contour families.
Loop breathing and traveling surface deformations are newly authored; the cropped feed sample does not establish the original algorithm or full motion.

studies.name: Curved mesh feather
intentionalDifferences: Independent long arcing spine with a folded point fan and twelve curved side filaments.
Local fan ripples, filament bending and slow sway approximate the observed feather-like silhouette; original source code and motion are not reproduced.

studies.name: Electric radial / icy filaments
intentionalDifferences: Independent warped polar ridges and multi-scale filaments approximate the observed icy radial relief; source shader and source animation are not reproduced.

studies.name: Icy ridge / layered flow
intentionalDifferences: Independent advecting ridge field preserves the diagonal bright edge, layered blue relief and dark lower-left crop; source geometry and motion are approximated.

studies.name: Warm corridor / recursive relief
intentionalDifferences: An original ray-marched square corridor uses repeated ribs and bounded relief. Fractal recursion, source geometry and physical lighting are not claimed.

studies.name: Glyph trails / luminous gestures
intentionalDifferences: Original analytic abstract gestures and temporal echoes approximate the observed luminous stroke family; source glyph paths and a TouchDesigner project are not reproduced.

studies.name: Temporal glyph / afterimages
intentionalDifferences: Four analytic wing lobes and center stem form an original bilateral glyph; temporal echoes and nested frames approximate the observed afterimage language. No source butterfly asset, exact timing or trail algorithm copied.

studies.name: Glass pixel glyphs / nine modules
intentionalDifferences: Nine independently drawn pixel glyphs are sampled inside analytic rounded glass tiles. Refraction, edge dispersion and highlights are illustrative, not physical cube ray tracing or source glyphs.

studies.name: Chromatic loops / granular surface
intentionalDifferences: Three independently positioned and rotating toroidal forms use surface shading and visible granular variation. Original arrangement and motion, rather than the source formula or exact topology.

studies.name: Technical keycaps / signal paths
intentionalDifferences: A generated original UI atlas contains device rows, keycaps, token and terminal; shader signals travel along its connectors and keycaps pulse. Decorative interaction diagram, not working authentication or copied UI/animation.
